Root cause: the dynamic build compiled generator expressions with the same eager loop as list comprehensions (`__out.push` per item at creation), so conditions, inner iterables and the element all ran when the genexp was written instead of when the consumer pulled. A `yield` anywhere except the outermost iterable is now refused (CPython syntax error).
